# tests/fixtures

Hand-written hex fixtures: the **independent** check of our layout tables against the spec.

- One file per message type plus the packet header (e.g. `add_order.hex` or a `constexpr` byte array in a header).
- Header comment: spec document, version, section, table; reviewer; review date.
- Use distinctive field values so an off-by-one offset is caught.
- **Written before `PillarEncoder` exists** and never generated by it.

Review with the [fixture review checklist](../../../../../docs/testing/fixture-review-checklist.md).
